name: Berain
desc: A Fontainian merchant merchant and heir to a branch of House Randolph. As a first-time visitor to Nod-Krai, he has unfortunately fallen victim to many scams due to his wealthy background and gullible character.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd680>Stage Introduction</color>
Crushed by endless taxes, Berain was worn down in both body and mind during his time in Nod-Krai, plagued by doubt and anxiety. Perhaps in search of some inner peace, he chose a deck themed around his homeland, hoping it might bring him some comfort.
<color=#ccbfad>Special Rule: Start with 1 "Tower of Ipsissimus" card on the opponent's side of the field.</color>
